# db-19 — DataBall must declare its relay profile for scripted landing

The agents-repo `relay-land.sh` (agents queue S59) reads each project's check commands and code paths from a `.relay-profile` file at the project root. Add DataBall's profile, and point `AGENTS.md`'s slice-relay section at it, so landing a DataBall slice is one scripted command instead of the hand sequence used for db-07 to db-09.

**Findings:** owner 2026-10-10 (relay scripts); agents-repo S59 · **Size:** S · **Tree:** databall

**2026-10-10** — Parked 2026-10-10 (owner): waits on agents-repo S59 (relay-land.sh); unpark when S59 lands.

trust: unverified; by: Jon R

**Not in this slice:** the scripts themselves (agents S57 to S59); slicer's `verify --landed` (slicer queue s245); changing which checks DataBall runs.

## Why

The owner decided on 2026-10-10 that deterministic relay chores become scripts. DataBall's check commands live only in the prose of `AGENTS.md` ("Build, test, format"). The land script needs them in a form it can read. The rule "rerun the check only when main gained code" also needs DataBall's code paths.

The format is defined by agents-repo S59: `key=value` lines and `#` comments, with keys `check` (repeatable), `code_paths`, `main` and `worktrees`.

This item waits on agents S59. slicer cannot express a dependency across repositories, so do not start it before S59 lands there.

## Files

- `.relay-profile` (new):
  - `check=dotnet build DataBall.sln -c Release`
  - `check=dotnet test DataBall.sln -c Release`
  - `check=dotnet format DataBall.sln --verify-no-changes`
  - `code_paths=src tests DataBall.sln Directory.Build.props global.json`
  - `main=main`
  - `worktrees=.worktrees`
- `AGENTS.md`, "Slice relay": say that landing reads `.relay-profile`, and that the build, test and format commands are listed there as well as under "Build, test, format". Keep the two lists identical.
